shots.on_screen: Curly-haired woman in lavender pyjamas at night checks dark spots in a hand mirror.
Overhead: she sketches a face in a notebook and circles the cheeks; jar beside.
She holds the jar out to camera.
Fingertip scoops thick cream; it pulls into a peak.
Cream dotted on forehead, cheeks, nose and chin; hands start smoothing.
Massaging cream in at the mirror.
Jar with three glowing orbs orbiting.
She sleeps; jar on lit nightstand.
Before/after split, after shows fewer-looking spots.
